Absorption Combat

Meinfoo (Pokémon) using Drain Punch on Hawlucha, draining it’s health and adding it to it’s own.

Power/Ability to:

Fuse physical combat with absorption.

The ability to combine absorption with physical fighting. Variation of Combat Merging and Absorption. Not to be confused with Theft Combat.

Capabilities[]

The user can combine absorption with physical fighting, allowing them to drain and steal the energy/power of others and convert it into their own through physical combat, which not only strengthens the user but also weakens their foes.

Applications[]

  • Energy Absorption
  • Enhanced Combat/Supernatural Combat
  • Metabolization

Associations[]

  • Absorption
  • Absorption Attacks
  • Combat Merging

Limitations[]

  • May become over-reliant on absorbing during fights.
  • Absorption Immunity/Absorption Negation

  • Osmosians (Ben 10)
  • L-Drago (Beyblade)

Gallery[]

Anime/Manga/Aeni/Manhwa[]

Yami Sukehiro (Black Clover) using his Dark Magic: Black Hole technique to absorb the magic in his opponent's attack.
Yhwach (Bleach) extending Blut Vene Anhaben to create a force-field that blocks incoming attacks and consumes everything around it, including living beings, in order to maintain itself.
Ōko Yushima (Bleach) using Hajō Kūri to absorb energy and converting it into blasts...
...using Renzan: Hajō Kūri to absorb energy at a much higher scale and firing it back as destructive beams.
Victor Powered (Buso Renkin) absorbs vitality from all around him simply by being there.
Android 19 (Dragon Ball Z) draining Goku's ki.
The Gedo Statue's Phantom Dragon Nine Seals (Naruto) massacre an army of Hidden Rain Ninjas by removing their souls from their bodies.
Madara Uchiha (Naruto) using Wood Release: Wood Dragon to drain the victims of their chakra, enough to even capture a Tailed Beast...
...and the Preta Path's Blocking Technique Absorption Seal to absorb an attack.
Kisame Hoshigaki (Naruto) using his Water Style: Super Shark Bomb Jutsu/Water Release: Great Shark Bullet Technique to absorb chakra from the opposing technique to increase its own strength, making the impact even more devastating.
Yoroi (Naruto) absorbing Sasuke's chakra.
Hiruko (Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire) can use his Shade Style: Black Hole to physical and spiritual energy of chakra within ninja and freely manipulate the victim's chakra element and perform ninjutsu of that element.
Yveltal (Pokémon) can use its signature move, Oblivion Wing, to drain its target's health and add it to its own.
Ainar Fenelin (Surviving The Game as a Barbarian) using her Vitality Absorption to passively absorb her opponents' stats while restoring her own HP after dealing damage to them.
